pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze: 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 named Bg7 as if White's bishop; plan 1 paired short castling with an h4-h5 storm. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (reviewer: first draft supported d4 with c3, where White's knight stands).

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Gurgenidze: 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.h3 Nf6 6.e5
pages.notes: Overview called it a French Advance structure with a kingside attack and ignored that 6.e5 hits the f6-knight; plan 1 pushed f4-f5 through the f3-knight; plan 2 rerouted the attacked knight via e8. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Finnish Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 challenged a Bf5 not yet on the board. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Karpov Variation, Modern Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 1-2 around ...Nf6 gaining time, Bd2/long castling and ...c5; British spelling in overview and plans 3-4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Steinitz, 5.Bc4 Ngf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 assumed ...gxf6 after Nxf6+ (the d7-knight recaptures); plan 4 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop to g7; plan 3's Qh5/h4-h5 was not this line's idea. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Steinitz, 5.Nf3 Ngf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Be7 before ...e6 and the bishop reaching g6 in one move; plan 3 called the e-file semi-open after ...exf6 (it is open). Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Steinitz, 5.Nf3 Ngf6 6.Nxf6+
pages.notes: Overview and plan 3 used ...gxf6 and a g7 fianchetto of the light-squared bishop; the real alternative is ...exf6. Rewrote overview and all three plans.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Steinitz, 5.Ng5 Ngf6 6.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Bxe6 (the d3-bishop can't reach e6) and Qe2-h5 sacrifices; overview missed the 6...h6? 7.Ne6 Bg6 mate trap. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence: Burris Gambit accepted
pages.notes: Plan 2 retreat squares written as bare d6/d8. Rewrote plan 2 with ...Qd8 or ...Qd5 after Nf3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence:Burris Gambit accepted
pages.notes: Overview and plans treated 6.Nf6+ as a sound gambit and plan 2 moved the queen while Black was in check; 6...Nxf6 7.Bxf5 Qe5+ leaves Black a knight and pawn up. Rewrote overview and plans (reviewer: first draft said the check forces a recapture, but 6...Kd8 is legal).
